mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the cost of capital for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as discount rates compress.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 4.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as recessionary risks intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) below 0.5% MoM indicate weakening consumer demand, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as economic growth falters.
candidate_trigger: HOUST decline > 0.5% MoM and RSAFS decline > 0.5% MoM
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline > 0.5% MoM, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising > 0.1pp/mo and CPIAUCSL rising > 0.1pp/mo) increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuation multiples, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rise > 0.1pp/mo, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Positive GDP growth (GDPC1) above 0.5% QoQ signals robust economic expansion, increasing corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth > 0.5% QoQ, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (index) indicates manufacturing contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as output growth stalls.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), labor market slack increases recession risk and reduces corporate profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous inflation (CPIAUCSL) and rate (FEDFUNDS) increases above 0.1pp/mo signal aggressive monetary tightening, reducing equity market liquidity and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS both rise > 0.1pp/mo, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
